An '''individual''' was a [[pirate]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="PastTheBarrier" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SkeletonDate">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> they were on [[Borgo Prime]] when two [[youngling]]s tried to pay a [[Unidentified fry cook|fry cook]] with an [[Galactic Republic|Old Republic]] [[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] causing a scene. The younglings ran away from the pirates at the noodle stand. Since they were not aware of the context they were confused as the younglings ran past them while being chased by a [[Unidentified greasy creature|greasy pirate]].<ref name="PastTheBarrier" />

==Behind the scenes==
The confused pirate appeared in the "[[Way, Way Out Past the Barrier]]," the second episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which premiered on [[December 2]], [[2024]]. They were performed by [[Kevin Foster]].<ref name="PastTheBarrier" />
